entries.title: Isaiah 14:1
segments: ¶For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

words.text: with them, and they shall cleave

entries.title: Isaiah 14:2
segments: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors. {whose...: Heb. that had taken them captives}

words.text: : and they shall take them captives
they were; and they shall rule
. {whose...: Heb. that had taken them captives}

entries.title: Isaiah 14:3
segments: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,

words.text: And it shall come to pass in the day
wherein thou wast made to serve

entries.title: Isaiah 14:4
segments: ¶That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased! {proverb: or, taunting speech} {golden...: or, exactress of gold}

words.text: ! {proverb: or, taunting speech} {golden...: or, exactress of gold}

entries.title: Isaiah 14:5
segments: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, [and] the sceptre of the rulers.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:6
segments: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, [and] none hindereth. {a continual...: Heb. a stroke without removing}

words.text: . {a continual...: Heb. a stroke without removing}

entries.title: Isaiah 14:7
segments: The whole earth is at rest, [and] is quiet: they break forth into singing.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:8
segments: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, [and] the cedars of Lebanon, [saying], Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:9
segments: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet [thee] at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, [even] all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations. {Hell: or, The grave} {chief...: Heb. leaders, or, great goats}

words.text: for thee, [even] all the chief ones
. {Hell: or, The grave} {chief...: Heb. leaders, or, great goats}

entries.title: Isaiah 14:10
segments: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?

words.text: unto thee, Art thou also become weak
as we? art thou become like

entries.title: Isaiah 14:11
segments: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, [and] the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:12
segments: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! [how] art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations! {O Lucifer: or, O day star}

entries.title: Isaiah 14:13
segments: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

entries.title: Isaiah 14:14
segments: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:15
segments: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.

words.text: Yet thou shalt be brought down

entries.title: Isaiah 14:16
segments: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, [and] consider thee, [saying, Is] this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;

entries.title: Isaiah 14:17
segments: [That] made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; [that] opened not the house of his prisoners? {opened...: or, did not let his prisoners loose homeward?}

words.text: ? {opened...: or, did not let his prisoners loose homeward?}

entries.title: Isaiah 14:18
segments: All the kings of the nations, [even] all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:19
segments: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, [and as] the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:20
segments: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, [and] slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:21
segments: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:22
segments: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:23
segments: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:24
segments: ¶The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, [so] shall it stand:

words.text: , so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed

entries.title: Isaiah 14:25
segments: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.

words.text: from off them, and his burden

entries.title: Isaiah 14:26
segments: This [is] the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this [is] the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:27
segments: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul [it]? and his hand [is] stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

words.text: , and who shall turn it back

entries.title: Isaiah 14:28
segments: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:29
segments: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit [shall be] a fiery flying serpent. {cockatrice: or, adder}

entries.title: Isaiah 14:30
segments: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:31
segments: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, [art] dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none [shall be] alone in his appointed times. {none...: or, he shall not be alone} {appointed...: or, assemblies}

words.text: . {none...: or, he shall not be alone} {appointed...: or, assemblies}

entries.title: Isaiah 14:32
segments: What shall [one] then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it. {trust...: or, betake themselves unto it}

words.text: in it. {trust...: or, betake themselves unto it}
